# Ragdoll

> Toggle a character into a physics ragdoll and back.

- Package: `Ragdoll` · Category: Effects
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: nothing else (only Core)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Ragdoll")` on the server

## `GaxiaServer.Ragdoll`

- Runs: **server only (Script / server ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ServerStorage/Gaxia_Packages_Server/Lib/RagdollService.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local GaxiaServer = require(game:GetService("ServerStorage").Gaxia_Packages_Server)
local Ragdoll = GaxiaServer.Ragdoll
```

### Functions

- `Ragdoll.Enable(character: Instance): boolean`
- `Ragdoll.Disable(character: Instance): boolean`
- `Ragdoll.IsRagdolled(character: Instance): boolean`
- `Ragdoll.Toggle(character: Instance): ()`
- `Ragdoll.WatchState(humanoid: Humanoid, fn: (old: Enum.HumanoidStateType, new: Enum.HumanoidStateType) -> ()): RBXScriptConnection`
- `Ragdoll.AutoRagdollOnDeath(character: Instance): RBXScriptConnection?`
  Convenience: ragdoll on death (still detector-driven — Died fires, we react).

### Signals

Connect with `:Connect(function(...) end)`; the parameters are the payload types, in order.

- `Ragdoll.OnRagdoll` — `Signal<Instance>`

- `Ragdoll.OnRecover` — `Signal<Instance>`
